bifrost: springboard/src/shell/books/engine/pdf/ (reader), springboard/ui/src/print.rs (Save as PDF, lp submission)
summary: BifrOSt has an internal PDF reader inside the Books app that loads a file, walks the page tree, extracts text, images and the outline, and reflows the result into the Books page model. Printing a PDF goes through the SDK print API. There is no app-facing PDF document, page, view, annotation, form, selection or thumbnail API.

features.apple: PDFView, PDFViewDelegate, currentPage, visiblePages, displayMode, scaling
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/pdfview.rs (PdfView, DisplayMode, page frames, scroll, navigation)
features.note: Headless tests in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-03.rs cover continuous and two-up page frames, visible and current pages, scroll clamping, scale factor and limits, autoscaling, go_to_page and next and previous page. Tests: continuous_pages_stack_one_per_row_with_the_page_gap_between_rows, visible_pages_are_the_frames_that_meet_the_viewport, current_page_is_the_row_that_crosses_the_middle_of_the_viewport, go_to_page_scrolls_the_row_to_the_top_and_refuses_unknown_pages, a_fixed_scale_scales_the_frames_and_the_content, a_fixed_scale_is_clamped_into_the_scale_limits, an_empty_view_has_no_pages_and_no_current_page. Not wired into apps or the shell; Books reflows text into its own page model, so Apple page geometry is not used; verify on Midget for parity.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/pdfpage.rs (PdfPage, PageBoxes, rotation, thumbnail_size, fit_scale, fit_transform)
features.note: Pure page geometry in springboard/ui/src/pdfpage.rs, tested in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-03.rs: unset boxes fall back along the chain (unset_boxes_fall_back_along_the_chain_to_the_media_box, setting_the_crop_box_moves_the_boxes_that_fall_back_to_it), rotation and displayed size (rotation_is_normalised_to_a_quarter_turn_and_odd_angles_are_refused, displayed_size_swaps_width_and_height_on_quarter_turns), aspect-fit thumbnail sizes (fit_scale_keeps_the_aspect_ratio_inside_the_target, a_rotated_thumbnail_fits_its_landscape_size_inside_a_square) and fit_transform_centres_the_page_in_the_target. No thumbnail image is rendered and no thumbnail view exists; the Books page panel (springboard/apps/books-desktop/src/books/mod.rs) is not covered by these tests; verify on Midget for parity.

Opens a document from bytes in memory, repairs a broken startxref and refuses bytes without a PDF header. Headless tests in springboard/render/tests/parity_sdk-tests-03.rs: bytes_without_a_pdf_header_are_refused, a_document_with_a_correct_cross_reference_lists_its_objects, a_broken_startxref_is_repaired_by_scanning_the_objects. No URL loading and no app-facing PDFDocument object; Books loads through its own engine (springboard/src/shell/books/engine/pdf/mod.rs), which these tests do not cover; verify on Midget for parity.

features.apple: PDFDocument read operations, page count, attributes
features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/cg/pdf/doc.rs (xref, object scan when the xref is bad), springboard/render/src/cg/pdf/obj.rs
features.note: Headless tests in springboard/render/tests/parity_sdk-tests-03.rs: a_document_with_a_correct_cross_reference_lists_its_objects (object numbers and object loading) and a_broken_startxref_is_repaired_by_scanning_the_objects. features.feature: PDFPage: page tree and text extraction
features.apple: PDFPage string, attributedString, characterBounds(at:), characterIndex(at:), numberOfCharacters
features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/cg/pdf/page.rs (pages, Page, page tree walk with inherited boxes), springboard/render/src/cg/pdf/extract.rs (Extractor, reading order text)
features.note: Headless tests in springboard/render/tests/parity_sdk-tests-03.rs: the_page_tree_walk_inherits_the_media_box_and_reads_the_rotation, a_crop_box_is_reported_for_its_page_and_falls_back_to_the_media_box_elsewhere, text_drawn_on_a_written_page_is_extracted_in_reading_order, an_empty_written_document_has_no_text_pieces. Text is extracted in reading order. No per-character bounds or index lookup. Built 2026-10-17: graphics_pdf::Document::find returns the pages whose text contains a phrase, ignoring case (tests graphics_pdf::tests::find_names_the_pages_whose_text_has_the_phrase).

features.apple: PDFPage draw(with:to:), transformContext(for:), thumbnail, display boxes, rotation
features.note: Offscreen page rasterisation in the engine is tested headless in springboard/render/tests/parity_sdk-tests-03.rs (a_filled_rectangle_is_rasterised_into_an_offscreen_picture, an_offscreen_picture_keeps_the_page_aspect_inside_the_requested_box); page geometry in springboard/ui/src/pdfpage.rs is tested in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-03.rs. Not built: drawing a PDF page into an app-provided context (no PDFPage draw API) and page thumbnails. JPEG 2000, CCITT and JBIG2 images are not shown; there is no SDK PDF page API.

features.feature: PDFPage: page image and PDF creation
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 11 tests. Wave 2 (theme-21, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No API to create a PDF page from an image or to serialize a page

features.note: The page annotation model keeps annotations in stacking order, hit-tests points, hides them as a whole, edits contents, colour and position in place, and lists annotations by kind. Headless tests in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-03.rs and springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-43.rs. Gap: the model does not read or write PDF annotation objects, and the Books notes wiring (springboard/apps/books-desktop/src/books/mod.rs) is not covered; verify on Midget for parity.

features.apple: PDFOutline: child(at:), label, destination, action, isOpen
features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/cg/pdf/page.rs (outline(): /Outlines flattened into title, destination page and level); springboard/render/src/cg/pdf/outline_tree.rs (outline_tree: nested OutlineNode)
features.note: Headless test the_outline_is_flattened_in_reading_order_with_levels_and_page_targets in springboard/render/tests/parity_sdk-tests-03.rs covers the flattened outline, and springboard/render/tests/parity_sdk-complete-42.rs covers the nested tree built from it. features.apple: PDFDocument write operations, PDFDocumentWriteOption, accessPermissions, password unlock (takePasswordFrom)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 6 (b10, main): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on Midget. Save as PDF copies the original bytes, so no page edits are written. Encrypted and password-protected files are not handled

features.apple: NSPrintOperation with PDFDocument printing (PDFDocument drawing into print context)
features.note: A PDF file job sends the file's own bytes with the application/pdf format, and a file job is named after its file: a_pdf_file_job_sends_the_file_bytes_unchanged and a_file_job_is_named_after_its_file_and_a_missing_file_is_refused in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-03.rs. Submission to CUPS (PrintOperation::run) is not covered; there is no page-level pagination or page range for PDF content (see docs/bifrost-ui.md:1322-1333); whether the Midget image ships CUPS is unchecked. Built 2026-10-17: a page list of several ranges is kept in PrintInfo::page_list (set by PageSelection::apply_to) and sent as one page-ranges attribute with a value per range (cups::merge_attributes joins the template); tests print::tests::several_page_ranges_become_one_attribute_with_a_value_per_range, cups::tests::merge_attributes_keeps_one_attribute_per_name_with_its_values_in_order, print_ranges::tests::one_range_goes_into_pages_and_several_into_the_page_list.
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 6 (b10, main): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on Midget. No overlay or markup view

gaps: No app-facing PDF page or view object in springboard/sdk/src (PDFPage, PDFView have no counterpart). graphics_pdf::Document has open, page count and size, render, outline and find; the PDF reader is otherwise private to the Books app.
No annotation, widget or form-field support (PDFAnnotation, AcroForm)
No page rendering into an app-provided context and no page thumbnails (PDFPage draw, PDFThumbnailView)
No text selection in PDFs (PDFSelection); find returns page indexes, not ranges of text.
No write path: Save as PDF copies the original file, so page edits, rotation and password handling cannot be written
Printing sends the file to CUPS unchanged; page ranges are set in the shell's print sheet (ui print_ranges.rs), but there is no pagination of PDF content (see docs/bifrost-ui.md:1322-1333)
